body: Dr. Meera, JIDA's Oct issue has a relevant finding for your 124 high-risk adult patients. A 2,100-patient trial shows 3-month fluoride recall cuts caries recurrence 38% better than 6-month intervals. Since your CTR is slightly below peer median, shifting your high-risk recall strategy could improve patient outcomes and engagement. Want me to pull the full abstract + draft a patient-ed WhatsApp message for this cohort? — JIDA Oct 2026 p.14
rationale: Uses specific high-risk patient count and JIDA research to provide clinical value, while linking to the merchant's performance metric (CTR) to encourage a strategic shift.

body: Dr. Meera, DCI circular 2026-11-04 just dropped: radiograph dose limits change effective 2026-12-15. Max dose per IOPA drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. D-speed film won't pass; E-speed or digital RVG is required. Audit your X-ray setup before the deadline to stay compliant. Want me to draft an SOP update for your clinic records so you're ready in time?
rationale: Uses high-urgency regulatory data (DCI circular) to provide immediate value, paired with a reciprocity-based offer to handle the compliance documentation.

body: Hi Priya, Dr. Meera's clinic here. It's been 6 months since your last visit, so your routine cleaning is due. Apke liye 2 slots ready hain: Wed 5 Nov, 6pm ya Thu 6 Nov, 5pm. We have your current offer active for ₹299. Reply 1 for Wed, 2 for Thu, or tell us a time that works for you.
rationale: Uses name personalization, hi-en mix, and specific slot availability to reduce friction for a lapsed customer.

body: Dr. Bharat, checking in. Your clinic's call volume dropped 50% this week (4 calls vs 12 baseline). With wedding season approaching, we typically see a 2x spike in whitening inquiries. Your profile is currently unverified, which may be impacting visibility. Want me to guide you through the 5-minute verification process to help recover those leads? Also, your Pro plan renewal is due in 12 days.
rationale: Uses performance dip data (-50%) to create urgency, leverages seasonal wedding whitening trends for relevance, and combines verification with renewal to drive action.

body: Bharat, your Pro plan at Bharat Dental Care expires in 12 days (₹4999). Your 7-day performance shows a dip in calls (-50%) and CTR (-10%). With 95 patients lapsed over 180 days, we should focus on re-engagement to boost those numbers. Want me to draft a recall campaign for your lapsed list to help recover some of that traffic before your renewal? It takes 5 minutes to set up.
rationale: Uses performance data (-50% calls) and lapsed patient count (95) to anchor the value of the Pro plan, while offering reciprocity to fix the dip.
